designationHistory.indexText: Quivira Refuge was established under these authorities and for these purposes: Migratory Bird Conservation Act (16 United States Code [U.S.C.] § 715d) for use as an inviolate sanctuary, or for any other management purpose, for migratory birds Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956 (16 U.S.C. § 742f(a)4) or the development, advancement, management, conservation, and protection of fish and wildlife resources
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.
